meta.description: Loan routes commonly used by women entrepreneurs, with indicative terms for EMI planning.
meta.disclaimer: Interest rates are indicative ranges for planning only. Actual rates depend on the lender, the repo-linked benchmark rate and your credit profile. Confirm with the lender before applying.

products.name: MUDRA Shishu loan
products.suits: Very small start-ups: home food business, tailoring, small shop equipment.

products.name: MUDRA Kishore loan
products.suits: Growing micro businesses that need equipment or working capital.

products.name: Stand-Up India composite loan
products.collateral: Primary security; CGSSI guarantee cover may replace collateral
products.suits: First-time (greenfield) enterprises needing Rs 10 lakh to Rs 1 crore.
products.notes: Repayment within 7 years with a moratorium of up to 18 months.

products.name: PMEGP bank loan with margin-money subsidy
products.collateral: Not required up to Rs 10 lakh; CGTMSE cover above
products.suits: New manufacturing or service units that qualify for the 25–35% subsidy.

products.name: Collateral-free MSME term loan (CGTMSE covered)
products.suits: Existing micro and small enterprises needing term loans or working capital.

products.name: SHG bank linkage loan
products.suits: SHG members; interest subvention can reduce the effective rate in eligible districts.

products.name: PM Vishwakarma concessional loan
products.suits: Registered artisans: Rs 1 lakh (18 months) then Rs 2 lakh (30 months).

products.name: PM SVANidhi working-capital loan
products.suits: Urban street vendors. 7% interest subsidy is credited for timely repayment.
